release_name: Senior BIM Engineer & Architect Sanity Gate, Adaptive Component Modeling & Freeform Massing Engine
highlights: Professional Role Mandate: AIGRAV officially elevated to Senior BIM Engineer & Architect (prohibits blind script execution and unconstructible geometry)

Triple-Layer Independent Validation: Added Layer 3 (Engineering Sanity Gate) auditing structural load paths, continuous column bearings, headroom clearance (min 2.20m), stair ergonomics, weatherproofing/roof slope, and site datum (+0.00 elevation)
Adaptive Component Modeling Engine: Standardized LOD 350-400 parametric component placement via AdaptiveComponentInstanceUtils as the official professional alternative to DirectShape
Conceptual Massing & Model By Face: Standardized freeform building skin modeling using OST_Mass converted directly to native BIM FaceWall, Roof, and CurtainSystem
Automated Sheet & Drawing Order Standardization: Zero-error contiguous numbering (01 to 72) with suffix removal (PD-001A to PD-002) and duplicate NO conflict resolution on live Revit models

Milestone-Based Modeling Orchestration Engine: Standardized 4-phase macro-execution (Datum & Structure -> Envelope -> Partitions & Openings -> Rooms & QTO) combining atomic TransactionGroups with visual checkpoint review
Multi-Zone PDA Test PDF Ingestion: Digital bookmarking and automated merging of WFG, Produksi, WRM, and detail drawings into unified sets
fixes: Strictly banned DirectShape.CreateElement for architectural and structural building elements across all AIGRAV operating procedures
Eliminated duplicate NO=25 parameter conflict between PD-001 and PD-001A in Revit document
Standardized mandatory 'Verdict Kelayakan BIM Engineer & Arsitek' in all execution summary reports
